name: team_planning_drift
description: Get the drift of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: every change the Org Graph learned on or after the plan's base date, up to today (days in the tenant's time zone), whatever day it took effect, in effective date order, as org_graph_changes_between by "learned" gives them for from (the day before the base date) and to (today). A change it no longer believes comes back withdrawn. Each change carries `meets`, the plan's latest change to the facet it moves, one per scenario that holds one (a scenario_id equal to the plan_id is the baseline), `from_plan`, true when the change was applied from this plan, and `sources`, who supplies what it moves: the provider of a person fact, whoever supplied a membership, or the providers of the units a unit or succession touches ("espalia" for one Espalia supplies, or an HRIS such as "hibob"). A person's placements are one facet, so a move in one placement meets the plan's whole list. A plan covering some units lists only changes about the people and units it covers, at its base, in any scenario, or placed in one of them since, including by a move known before the base that takes effect after it. Such a move decides coverage from its own day but is not listed. A change that takes one of them out, or a covered person now reporting to someone the plan can't show, keeps the fact and nulls what lies outside; a joiner keeps only the units and manager the plan covers. A change that took effect before the base nulls `before`. `outside` lists the fields nulled or trimmed. People are named by id, and `names` maps every person and unit id the changes name to a name, but a scoped plan names only the units it covers today; a forgotten person reads as "Former member". An archived plan is not checked: it returns checked: false, archived_on and a note, with nothing listed, so an empty list never reads as nothing wrong. Restoring the plan checks it again; otherwise checked is true. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
